summary: An internal memo describing the datacomputer from a user's point of view. It was planned as a special ARPANET node devoted to managing a very large shared database, with a single data language used to describe and request data. The first service offering is described, along with how users reach it through access methods.

eli5.summary: A giant shared filing cabinet attached to the network. You talk to it in one special language that tells it what you want to store or fetch.
